pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-mail-inspector against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.4 §12, gate 20): every kind of field, typed text across redraws, each event, section memory, the list verbs, the path and the tabs
pages.format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

checks.title: every kind is drawn as its Framework element, and a hint is real text under the field

steps.check: (() => { const q = (s) => one.querySelector(s); return q('sf-input[data-path="/text"]') && q('sf-input[data-path="/url"]') && q('sf-input[data-path="/discount"]') && q('sf-textarea[data-path="/note"]') && q('sf-dropdown[data-path="/tone"]') && q('sf-switch[data-path="/wide"]') && q('[data-path="/image"] sf-image-field') && q('[data-group="/price"] .sf-mail-inspector-pair sf-input[data-path="/price/old"]') && q('[data-items="/items"] sf-sortable [data-item="2"].has-problem') && q('sf-textarea[data-path="/note"]').textContent.includes('Как в бренде') && q('.sf-mail-inspector-title').textContent === 'Кнопка' && one.querySelectorAll('.sf-mail-inspector-action').length === 2 && !q('sf-breadcrumbs') && one.querySelectorAll('.sf-accordion').length === 5 && native('/discount').inputMode === 'numeric' && native('/url').type === 'url' && native('/price/current').inputMode === 'decimal' && q('[data-path="/image"] sf-dropdown'); })()

checks.title: text the host did not take stays across redraws, marked, with the focus and the caret where they were

steps.script: (() => { const input = put('/url', 'x'); globalThis.input = input; input.setSelectionRange(3, 3); one.sections = withField('/url', {error: 'Нужен адрес https://'}); return true; })()

steps.check: native('/url') === input && document.activeElement === input && input.value === 'https://simai.rux' && input.selectionStart === 3 && input.selectionEnd === 3 && one.querySelector('sf-input[data-path="/url"]').hasAttribute('invalid') && one.querySelector('sf-input[data-path="/url"]').dataset.draft === 'true' && one.querySelector('sf-input[data-path="/url"]').textContent.includes('Нужен адрес') && JSON.stringify(heard) === JSON.stringify([['change', {path: '/url', value: 'https://simai.rux', typed: true}]])

steps.script: (() => { document.execCommand('insertText', false, 'Q'); one.sections = withField('/url', {error: 'Нужен адрес https://'}); return true; })()
(() => { input.blur(); one.sections = withField('/url', {error: 'Нужен адрес https://'}); return true; })()
(() => { one.sections = withField('/url', {value: 'https://ok.ru'}); return true; })()

checks.title: a late answer of the host never overwrites the field being typed in; leaving it shows the host's value

steps.script: (() => { globalThis.input = put('/text', ' сейчас'); one.sections = withField('/text', {value: 'Подробнее сей'}); return true; })()

steps.check: document.activeElement === input && input.value === 'Подробнее сейчас' && input.selectionStart === input.value.length

steps.script: (() => { input.blur(); return true; })()

checks.title: a text area and a field in a group keep a draft the same way

steps.script: (() => { put('/price/current', 'abc'); one.sections = withField('/price/current', {error: 'Нужно число'}); return true; })()
(() => { globalThis.area = put('/note', 'Первая строка'); area.setSelectionRange(2, 2); one.sections = withField('/note', {error: 'Слишком длинно'}); return true; })()

steps.check: native('/note') === area && area.value === 'Первая строка' && document.activeElement === area && area.selectionStart === 2 && one.querySelector('sf-textarea[data-path="/note"]').hasAttribute('invalid')

checks.title: a choice, a switch and a typed link each say change, and the element changes nothing

steps.script: (() => { one.querySelector('sf-dropdown[data-path="/tone"]').selectValue('muted'); const toggle = one.querySelector('sf-switch[data-path="/wide"] input'); toggle.click(); return true; })()

steps.check: JSON.stringify(heard) === JSON.stringify([['change', {path: '/tone', value: 'muted', typed: false}], ['change', {path: '/wide', value: true, typed: false}]])

steps.script: (() => { one.sections = base(); return true; })()

checks.title: a file says attach, a removal detach, a required image stays and says why, a refused file brings the stored image back, and a choice is a change

steps.script: (() => { const well = one.querySelector('[data-path="/image"] sf-image-field'); globalThis.file = new File(['probe'], 'new.png', {type: 'image/png'}); well.takeFile(file, 'input'); return true; })()

steps.check: heard.length === 1 && heard[0][0] === 'attach' && heard[0][1].path === '/image' && heard[0][1].files[0] === file && one.querySelector('[data-path="/image"] sf-image-field').value.href.startsWith('blob:')

steps.script: (() => { one.sections = withField('/image', {error: 'Файл слишком большой'}); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.sections = base(); return true; })()
(() => { one.querySelector('[data-path="/image"] sf-image-field').removeImage(); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.querySelector('[data-path="/logo"] sf-image-field').removeImage(); return true; })()
(() => { one.querySelector('[data-choose="/image"]').selectValue('a2'); return true; })()

checks.title: the heading's buttons say duplicate and delete, a pinned place's says replace, and an action not offered is refused

steps.script: (() => { one.querySelector('[data-action="duplicate"]').click(); one.querySelector('[data-action="delete"]').click(); globalThis.notOffered = one.replace().reason; return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.headActions = ['replace']; return true; })()
(() => { one.querySelector('[data-action="replace"]').click(); return true; })()

checks.title: a section closes, is told, stays closed under new data with the same key, and comes back from the host's list

steps.script: (() => { one.querySelector('[data-section="button:look"] .sf-accordion-trigger').click(); return true; })()

steps.check: JSON.stringify(heard) === JSON.stringify([['toggle', {key: 'button:look', open: false}]]) && one.querySelector('[data-section="button:look"] .sf-accordion-content').hidden && one.querySelector('[data-section="button:look"] .sf-accordion-trigger').getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && JSON.stringify(one.closedSections) === JSON.stringify(['button:look'])

steps.script: (() => { one.setAttribute('form-key', 'b8'); one.sections = base(); return true; })()
(() => { one.closedSections = ['button:content']; return true; })()
(() => { const data = base(); one.sections = [data[0]]; return true; })()

checks.title: an item opens, adds, copies, removes and moves, each told with its list, and the focus goes to the item that changed

steps.script: (() => { one.querySelector('[data-items="/items"] [data-toggle="1"]').click(); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; const data = withField('/items', {open: 1}); one.sections = data; return true; })()
(() => { one.querySelector('[data-item-add="/items"]').click(); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.openItemMenu('/items', 1, one.querySelector('[data-item-menu="1"]')); one.onMenuSelect({id: 'duplicate'}); return true; })()
(() => { one.onMenuSelect({id: 'remove'}); return true; })()
(() => { one.onMenuSelect({id: 'up'}); return true; })()
(() => { one.onMenuSelect({id: 'down'}); return true; })()

steps.check: JSON.stringify(heard) === JSON.stringify([['item-duplicate', {path: '/items', index: 1}], ['item-delete', {path: '/items', index: 1}], ['item-move', {path: '/items', from: 1, to: 0}], ['item-move', {path: '/items', from: 1, to: 2}]])

steps.script: (() => { one.sections = base(); return true; })()

checks.title: any item moves anywhere: first to last, by drag and by keys, and the ends only refuse going beyond them

steps.script: (() => { globalThis.answers = [one.itemMove({path: '/items', index: 0, to: 2}).outcome, one.itemMove({path: '/items', index: 2, to: 0}).outcome, one.itemMove({path: '/items', index: 0, by: -1}).reason, one.itemMove({path: '/items', index: 2, by: 1}).reason, one.itemMove({path: '/nope', index: 0, by: 1}).reason]; return true; })()

steps.check: answers.join(',') === 'applied,applied,unchanged,unchanged,unknown' && JSON.stringify(heard) === JSON.stringify([['item-move', {path: '/items', from: 0, to: 2}], ['item-move', {path: '/items', from: 2, to: 0}]])

steps.script: (() => { heard.length = 0; const list = one.querySelector('[data-items="/items"] sf-sortable'); list.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sf-sortable-move', {bubbles: true, detail: {item: 'item-2', from: list.getAttribute('group'), to: list.getAttribute('group'), index: 0}})); return true; })()

(() => { heard.length = 0; const toggle = one.querySelector('[data-toggle="1"]'); toggle.focus(); toggle.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'ArrowUp', altKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true})); return true; })()

checks.title: at max nothing is added or copied, at min nothing is removed, and the buttons say so

steps.script: (() => { one.sections = withField('/items', {max: 3, min: 3}); return true; })()

steps.check: one.itemAdd({path: '/items'}).reason === 'full' && one.itemDuplicate({path: '/items', index: 0}).reason === 'full' && one.itemDelete({path: '/items', index: 0}).reason === 'least' && one.querySelector('[data-item-add="/items"]').hasAttribute('disabled') && heard.length === 0 && one.menuEntries(fieldOf(one.sections, '/items'), 0).filter((entry) => entry.disabled).map((entry) => entry.id).join(',') === 'up,duplicate,remove'

checks.title: the path is drawn from two levels; a press and Escape ask for a level, and Escape takes the focus from a closing item to its row

steps.script: (() => { one.levels = [{text: 'Кнопка'}, {text: 'Расширенный'}]; one.sections = withField('/items', {open: 1}); return true; })()
(() => { const crumbs = one.querySelector('sf-breadcrumbs'); globalThis.crumbs = crumbs; crumbs.querySelector('a').click(); return true; })()

(() => { heard.length = 0; globalThis.input = native('/items/1/title'); input.focus(); globalThis.escape = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, cancelable: true}); input.dispatchEvent(escape); return true; })()
(() => { one.levels = [{text: 'Кнопка'}]; one.sections = base(); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; native('/text').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, cancelable: true})); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.levels = []; return true; })()

(() => { globalThis.free = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, cancelable: true}); native('/text').dispatchEvent(free); globalThis.atTop = one.levelUp().reason; return true; })()

checks.title: tabs show the form and the host's panels from slots; a press says tab, the host's tab moves it, and a draft in the form survives

steps.script: (() => { const brand = document.createElement('div'); brand.id = 'brand-panel'; brand.textContent = 'Панель бренда'; one.setSlot('brand', brand); one.tabs = [{id: 'content', label: 'Основное'}, {id: 'brand', label: 'Бренд', slot: 'brand'}, {id: 'images', label: 'Картинки', slot: 'images'}, {id: 'versions', label: 'Версии', slot: 'versions'}]; one.setAttribute('tab', 'content'); return true; })()

steps.check: one.querySelector('sf-tabs [data-tab="content"] sf-input[data-path="/text"]') && one.querySelector('sf-tabs [data-tab="brand"] #brand-panel') && one.querySelectorAll('sf-tabs [role="tab"]').length === 4 && one.querySelector('sf-tabs [data-tab="content"]').closest('[role="tabpanel"]').hidden === false && one.querySelector('sf-tabs [data-tab="brand"]').closest('[role="tabpanel"]').hidden === true

steps.script: (() => { heard.length = 0; globalThis.input = put('/url', 'x'); one.sections = withField('/url', {error: 'Нужен адрес https://'}); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; [...one.querySelectorAll('sf-tabs [role="tab"]')][1].click(); return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.setAttribute('tab', 'content'); return true; })()
(() => { const next = document.createElement('div'); next.id = 'brand-next'; one.setSlot('brand', next); return true; })()

checks.title: with real key presses: typing through redraws loses nothing, Enter and Space open an item, Alt+arrows move it, Shift+F10 opens its menu, Escape goes up

steps.script: (() => { globalThis.input = native('/text'); input.focus(); input.setSelectionRange(9, 9); globalThis.redraws = setInterval(() => { one.sections = withField('/text', {error: 'Не подходит'}); }, 5); return true; })()
(() => { clearInterval(redraws); return true; })()

steps.check: input === native('/text') && document.activeElement === input && input.value === 'Подробнееabdc' && input.selectionStart === 12 && heard.at(-1)[1].value === 'Подробнееabdc'

steps.script: (() => { heard.length = 0; one.sections = base(); one.querySelector('[data-toggle="0"]').focus(); return true; })()

steps.check: JSON.stringify(heard) === JSON.stringify([['item-toggle', {path: '/items', index: 0, open: true}], ['item-toggle', {path: '/items', index: 0, open: true}]])

steps.script: (() => { heard.length = 0; return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.sections = base(); return true; })()

checks.title: a new form-key draws the form anew and drops what was typed; the notice's button says so

steps.script: (() => { put('/url', 'x'); one.sections = withField('/url', {error: 'Нужен адрес https://'}); return true; })()

(() => { native('/url').blur(); one.setAttribute('form-key', 'b8'); one.sections = withField('/url', {error: 'Другая ошибка'}); one.notice = {text: 'Причина получения и ссылка отписки — в параметрах письма.', action: 'Открыть параметры письма'}; return true; })()
(() => { heard.length = 0; one.querySelector('[data-notice-action]').click(); return true; })()
